modmenu.descriptionTranslation.kaleidosc: Adds player-skin dolls to Kaleidoscope Doll. Put wool in the computer, type a player name and generate a doll with that player's skin.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_doll_player.skin_lo: Right-click a placed player doll, or pick this up and right-click a player doll in your inventory.
message.kaleidoscope_doll_player.skin_lo: The doll's skin is now locked.
This doll's skin is already locked.
Could not save the doll's skin. Wait for its player skin to load and try again.
The doll or snapshot moved or changed. Nothing was used.
gui.kaleidoscope_doll_player.computer.ge: Generate Player Doll: enter a player name or a direct skin PNG URL (leave blank for your own skin). Click to make one, or Shift-click to use all wool.
gui.kaleidoscope_doll_player.computer.in: Enter a player name or a direct HTTP(S) skin PNG URL.
gui.kaleidoscope_doll_player.computer.sk: Could not load the skin. Use a direct link to a 64x64 or 64x32 PNG without redirects.
gui.kaleidoscope_doll_player.computer.wo: Put wool in the computer first.
